text.en: The provisions of Section 2 of PD 701 is hereby amended to read as follows:

Section 8, Article IV of Republic Act 917, as amended, is hereby further amended to add one
subparagraph to allocate maintenance funds for feeder roads or Farm-to-Market Roads, to read as follows:
"Section 8. National Aid Highway Maintenance Fund. The apportionment for national aid for maintenance of
local roads shall be determined as follows:
(h) National aid for maintenance per physical kilometer of barangay roads shall be 40% of the current basic
cost of maintenance for each equivalent maintenance kilometer (EMK) of national high ways, subject to
availability of funds. The existence of barangay road is determined by the Barangay Council, verified by the
Highway District/City Engineer and Highway Regional Director, recommended by the Director of Barangay
Roads and approved by the Secretary of Public Highways or his designated representative."
Section 2. All laws, rules and regulations inconsistent with the provisions of this decree are hereby
amended, revoked or modified accordingly.

This decree shall take effect immediately.
Done in the City of Manila, this 11th day of June, in the year of Our Lord, nineteen, hundred and
seventy-eight.
